layout.title: Privacy Policy
layout.intro: How we collect and use your personal information, in line with the Data Protection and Privacy Act, 2019 of Uganda.

sections.heading: Who we are
sections.body: Snow Holdings Limited is responsible for the personal information collected through this website.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body:
We only collect the information you choose to give us, for example when you:

  • send a request through a contact or call-back form (such as your name, phone number, email and message);
  • contact us by email or WhatsApp.

sections.heading: How we use it
sections.body:
• to respond to your enquiry or request a call back;
  • to prepare quotes and discuss your project;
  • to keep in touch about work we are doing for you.

We do not sell your personal information.

sections.heading: Sharing
sections.body: We share your information only where needed to answer your request or deliver your project, for example with our team, or with service providers that help us run this website and receive form submissions, or where required by law.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
sections.body: We keep your information only for as long as we need it for the purposes above, or as required by law.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: Under the Data Protection and Privacy Act, 2019 you may ask to access, correct or delete the personal information we hold about you, or object to how we use it. Contact us using the details below.
